_note: One plain-English line per box hadith card, printed on the card's back under the label 'In our words'. These are Noor Post's own words, NOT a translation: the saying itself is quoted exactly on the front from the fixed edition, per sourcing-rules.md. Written 2026-10-09 for a reader of about ten. DRAFT: each line must be checked by the scholar against the Arabic before print — a gloss that drifts from the meaning is worse than none. Envelopes with no saying selected (06, 10) have no gloss.

glosses.01: Being too mean even to say hello is the worst kind of stingy.
glosses.02: People who ask for advice before they decide end up doing the right thing.
glosses.03: If there is no kindness in you, you are missing every good thing.
glosses.04: A foolish person says whatever they feel. A wise person thinks before they speak.
glosses.05: Nothing goes together better than being gentle and knowing a lot.
glosses.07: What you are worth is the thing you do really well.
glosses.08: A good neighbour does not just avoid causing trouble. A good neighbour puts up with the trouble the neighbours cause.
glosses.09: Your tongue is too good for rude words.
glosses.11: This world is like a market: some people come out ahead, and some lose.
glosses.12: Be kind to people, and they will trust you to settle their arguments.
glosses.13: Being quiet is a door to being wise. It makes friends, and it leads to every good thing.
glosses.14: Showing something off before it is ready spoils it.

companions.salman: Stay close to your family, even if all you can do is say hello.
companions.bilal: Being a believer is half staying patient when things are hard, and half saying thank you when they are good.
companions.abu-dharr: Learn from people who know things, talk with people who are wise, and spend time with people who have little.
companions.sumayyah: Wise people care about what God thinks, not about what powerful people think.
companions.nusaybah: A believer's good name, belongings and life must never be harmed.
companions.umm-ayman: We love the people who are good to us, and we pull away from the people who hurt us.
companions.halima: Being gentle makes everything better. Being rough spoils everything.
companions.asma: Choose who you travel with before you set off.
companions.maytham: You cannot really taste faith until you stop lying — even as a joke.
companions.qambar: When one person rides and another walks behind, it is bad for both of them.
companions.malik: The person who could punish the most is the one best able to forgive.
companions.fatima-bint-asad: Look after children who have no parents. Never let them go hungry or be left to struggle while you are there.
companions.qais: If you trust that God chooses what is good for you, you will not wish you were somewhere else.
companions.abbas: Be kind to everyone, the way rain falls on everyone.
companions.umm-kulthum: Stay away from doing things you will have to say sorry for.
companions.zaynab: If you try to get something by disobeying God, you will not get it — and you will end up with what you were afraid of.
companions.ruqayya: Never be unfair to someone who has nobody to stand up for them except God.
companions.tawus: Lots of people are fooled when others praise them.
companions.jabir: Be good, work hard, tell the truth, and give back what people trust you with — whoever they are.
companions.hisham: If you know something, you owe it to the people around you to teach it.
companions.umm-farwa: Be good to your parents, and your own children will be good to you.
companions.safwan: If you have to work for unfair rulers, make up for it by being kind to your friends.
companions.dibil: When someone is with you, call them by their respectful name. When they are not there, you can use their own name.
companions.masuma: An older brother is like a father.
companions.ali-ibn-mahziyar: A believer needs three things: help from God, a voice inside that keeps them on track, and good advice they listen to.
companions.abu-hashim: When something good happens, be even happier that you remembered to say thank you.
companions.ahmad-ibn-ishaq: If you need to correct a friend, do it quietly, just between you. Doing it in front of others embarrasses them.
companions.uthman: A true believer is a gift to other believers, and a proof to those who do not believe.
